source.author: Emre Gulher
source.title_as_extracted_from_repository_cover: Temporal and Spatial Variability of Black Sea Hydrodynamics and Chlorophyll: A Concentration with Connection to Wind Forcing

review_mode: Original source PDF parsed and three full rendered pages visually inspected; one idle local CPU. No ocean fields processed and no browser or runtime work performed locally.

source_context.methods_locator: Chapter V, printed page 65 / PDF page 90
source_context.july_narrative_locator: Printed page 67 / PDF page 92, extracted text only
source_context.time_support: The source describes monthly climatological averages, obtained from AVISO geostrophic velocities. Its methods mention available data for 1992-2012 and a focus on 1999-2009; the reviewed figure captions do not provide separate input-date lists.
source_context.named_context: The January narrative explicitly reports an anticyclonic Bosphorus eddy; the July narrative calls it developing. These are author interpretations of climatological fields, not dated individual detections.

decision.reason: The panels show geostrophic-current arrows over geographic axes, without a separately named Bosphorus boundary, numeric horizontal size, or boundary operator. The plotted velocity key does not define an eddy extent. Measuring an arbitrarily selected arrow cluster would introduce an undeclared boundary assumption.
decision.source_case_not_created: A monthly climatological average is not an individual dated eddy. Do not use January and July interpretations as observed annual bounds or continuous life history.
decision.next_evidence_needed: A named, dated contour or reported dimension; alternatively a separately specified reproducible field-based boundary operator with explicit geographical attribution and candidate status.

separate_figure_acquisition.locator: Korotaev et al. (2003), Figure 11 PowerPoint link exposed by the public publisher full-text page.
